nom: Clarins Hydrating Toning Lotion with Aloe Vera

avis.texte: I’ve been using this toner as part of my daily skincare routine and really enjoy it. It feels refreshing and hydrating without being sticky. My skin feels clean, balanced, and soft after use. Works well for sensitive skin. The price is higher than drugstore options, but the quality reflects it. Who I recommend it for: Great for normal to dry or sensitive skin types. High-quality toner that delivers hydration and comfort.

I am rewriting this review. My previous experience of using this toner was rather chemically than expected on my skin as well as in scent. Although my face did not break out after using it down to the half of bottle, it somehow gets really itchy at nights and I am not sure whether it is from the toner. Nonetheless moisturizing effects on the skin is definitely noticeable so I am willing to continue on this one little longer. The scent for me is still..meh..

avis.titre: Great light toner for sensitive skin and very hydrating
avis.texte: This is the toner I use for years, it's great for sensitive skin and hydration. Sephora stopped carrying it so I'm really glad to find it here on Amazon with 2-day shipping. Leaves my skin smooth and does not cause any redness. I use it right after the shower before my moisturizer.

avis.titre: I keep coming back to this toner
avis.texte: I'm so in love with this toner. Been getting it for years. It provides such a good hydration, I'm thinking because of the aloe? And I love the scent too! Just feels so luxe using this that I don't even want to shop around anymore lol. This is my go-to for life. Definitely worth giving a try, I say!
Clarins is the best! I love this toner. Face feels clean and bright!! 3rd time purchasing!
Bought at a good price. Gentle perfume. Like using this toner. No adverse reactions. Will purchase again.
Ganhei uma amostra grátis na Sephora e logo quis adquirir um maior. Tem um cheirinho muito agradável!
